headline_cluster.headline: מדבקה תאבחן מחלות עוד לפני הסימפטומים. כן, באמת. זה לא מדע בדיוני

primary_source_search_status: found_partial: Article body egress-blocked/paywalled (body_ok 0); claims reconstructed from headline + search-indexed alt titles ("החזון של חוסאם חאיק: מדבקה קטנה תאבחן מחלות בגופנו, עוד לפני הסימפטומים"; "זה לא מדע בדיוני, זה בפיתוח: מדבקה קטנה תגלה מחלות עוד לפני הסימפטומים"). Subject: Prof. Hossam Haick (Technion), VOC-sensing skin patch. Closest primary sources: Vishinkin et al., "Profiles of Volatile Biomarkers Detect Tuberculosis from Skin", Advanced Science 2021 (doi 10.1002/advs.202100235) and EU Horizon 2020 A-Patch project (CORDIS 824270, 2019-2023, TRL 4-5 prototype validation). Full-text pages (PMC, CORDIS) egress-blocked; figures taken from indexed abstracts/snippets. No published study located reporting pre-symptomatic detection or a lead time by a Haick skin patch.
clustering_note: Single-outlet story (Haaretz magazine weekend profile, published 2026-09-30, homepage rank 1).

claims.claim_text: מדבקה תאבחן מחלות עוד לפני הסימפטומים (homepage headline; implies demonstrated pre-symptomatic diagnosis, reinforced by 'כן, באמת. זה לא מדע בדיוני')
claims.source_figure: Adv. Sci. 2021 TB study: 636 participants (South Africa, India), offline sensor-array stages; 92% sensitivity, 80.4% specificity, 84.9% accuracy discriminating ACTIVE pulmonary TB patients from non-TB; the on-skin wearable was only an exploratory pilot. A-Patch (EU H2020) ended 2023 at TRL 4-5 prototype validation. No reported pre-symptomatic detection or lead time.
claims.note: Underlying research is real, but published evidence concerns detecting already-active (diagnosed) TB, not disease before symptoms, and the patch is a lab/hospital-validated prototype, not a clinical product. Haaretz's own indexed alt titles frame it as 'החזון של' / 'זה בפיתוח' — the homepage headline drops that qualifier and states it in definite future tense. Body unread, so the article itself may carry the caveat.

claims.source_figure: Patch-specific published validation is for tuberculosis only. Multi-disease 'fingerprint' evidence in Haick's lab comes from exhaled-breath VOC sensors (Na-Nose/SniffPhone), a different modality.
claims.note: Multi-disease scope is plausible as a research goal and supported for breath analysis, but not demonstrated for the skin patch; headline merges the two lines of work. Low confidence: body text not readable.

audit_note: Body paywalled/egress-blocked (body_ok 0); only headline-level claims judged. Framing phrase "כן, באמת. זה לא מדע בדיוני" not judged on its own (no figure), used only as context for maturity claim. Primary-source full texts (PMC, CORDIS) also egress-blocked; figures from indexed abstracts. Worst verdict: overstated.
